supersedesDescriptionOf.note: v3-final-freeze.json is preserved unchanged for audit history. Its label 'Final experimental freeze with all artifacts' and its next-step 'Paper submitted to venue' are invalid and are overridden by this manifest.

description: Reclassification of the artifacts previously labelled v3-final-freeze. This package is an instrumentation validation and reduced live execution package, not a completed experiment and not a final experimental freeze.

reducedConfirmatoryStream.characterization: A live execution and release-policy diagnostic over one commercial model lane. Not a completed confirmatory study.

attackSuite.nature: Deterministic test-double oracle outcomes; no live attacks were executed against real implementations.

dpExperiments.nature: Deterministic test-double outputs; no real DP-SGD training was performed.

evidenceVerification.nature: Deterministic test-double outputs; no real evidence bundles were produced or verified.

availabilityOverhead.nature: Deterministic test-double outputs with generated timings; no measured wall-clock executions.

statisticalReport.nature: Computed from the test-double streams above; additionally, its AUR and UIR formulas do not implement the preregistered metric definitions (see docs/v3/METRIC_CORRECTION.md).

limitations: Attack results are deterministic test doubles
DP results are deterministic test doubles
Evidence-verification results are deterministic test doubles
Availability and overhead results are deterministic test doubles
Only the reduced Gemma OpenRouter lane used live provider execution
Primary research claims are not permitted

Every live confirmatory event transmitted only source_record_id; no financial fields and no confidential fields reached the model, so the stream cannot support purpose-selectivity claims (see docs/v3/TRANSMITTED_FIELD_AUDIT.md)
B0 and P3 projections were identical in the live stream; the condition flag had no effect on transmitted data
Live stream has one model, unequal B0/P3 counts, unequal dataset coverage, 66 release denials from truncated non-JSON outputs, and 1 provider timeout

AUR.reason: Computed as P3 execution pass rate / B0 execution pass rate; not Authorized Utility Retention.

UIR.reason: Computed as release denials / total executions; a release-denial rate, not Unauthorized Influence Rate.

SPCR.reason: Derived from a test-double attack oracle; no live attacks executed.

EVC.reason: Derived from test-double evidence verification; no real evidence bundles verified.

availability.reason: Derived from test-double availability stream; no measured executions.

overhead.reason: Derived from generated timings; no wall-clock measurement.

next_steps: Rebuild the paired benchmark with real task utility and the full ten-condition matrix
Execute live attacks, real DP-SGD, real evidence verification, and measured overhead
Produce v3-live-non-tee-experimental-freeze only after those results and human review
